definitions.explanation: A volcano considered no longer capable of erupting. The traditional classification opposed {死火山|しかざん} to {活火山|かっかざん} (active) and {休火山|きゅうかざん} (dormant), though modern Japanese geology has largely abandoned this three-way split.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{死火山|しかざん}だ。
examples.english: That mountain is an extinct volcano.

examples.japanese: {死火山|しかざん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれていた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A mountain that had been called an extinct volcano erupted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧、⟦{気象庁|きしょうちょう}→気象庁：30107_kishouchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{死火山|しかざん}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{区分|くぶん}→区分：00248_kubun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず、すべて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活火山|かっかざん}→活火山：15901_kakkazan⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{扱|あつか}っている→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: Currently, the Meteorological Agency does not use the category "extinct volcano," instead treating all volcanoes as active.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (dead) + ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧ (volcano). The label is now considered scientifically unreliable because some "extinct" volcanoes have erupted again.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{活火山|かっかざん}→活火山：15901_kakkazan⟧: active volcano — currently or recently erupting
- ⟦{休火山|きゅうかざん}→休火山：28330_kyuukazan⟧: dormant volcano — not active, but potentially capable of erupting
- ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧: volcano
- ⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧: eruption

USAGE:
Still common in general speech and older textbooks, but rare in current scientific writing. Japanese volcanology now classifies volcanoes that have erupted in the last 10,000 years as ⟦{活火山|かっかざん}→活火山：15901_kakkazan⟧.
